target: Phase 002D-R2 clean-room provenance registry, four frozen component specifications, and implementation embargo

findings.claim: The allowed artifacts contain normalized frozen specifications and reviewed_by role labels but no immutable author bundle hash, raw author output hash, normalization diff, role session identity, peer-visibility record, expected-conclusion visibility, or author/normalizer/auditor separation record. Raw-output preservation, identity blindness, and prevention of same-agent role reuse therefore cannot be audited.
findings.recommended_test: DET-CRP-ROLE-CHAIN: require for each component an append-only record of role, pseudonymous session identity, frozen input-bundle hash, peer/expected-conclusion visibility flags, raw-output hash, normalized-output hash, canonical diff hash, and distinct author/normalizer/auditor identities; reject reuse, missing raw bytes, or material normalization changes.

findings.claim: Hidden-answer exclusion is not demonstrated. The claim-evidence specification names a CASE-006 oracle fixture and the comparison provenance names CASE-004 oracle requirements, but no allowed access ledger, exposure classification, demotion record, or hash-bound proof distinguishes permitted requirements from hidden or validation answers.
findings.recommended_test: DET-CRP-HIDDEN-ACCESS: replay a frozen per-role access ledger against an allowlist of requirement-only hashes; reject any oracle/answer/vault read, missing event, or post-exposure held-out classification, and require permanent development demotion for exposed cases.

findings.claim: Source provenance is incomplete or ambiguous: accepted-versus-done records an observed mechanism with empty inspiration, commit, and path fields; leakage-safe comparison names an inspiration and commit but no source path; all external inspirations have UNKNOWN or UNVERIFIED license status. These records do not support file-level source identification or license-bound reuse audit.
findings.recommended_test: DET-CRP-SOURCE-COMPLETE: require each mechanism to declare PROJECT_NATIVE with a project source/hash or external inspiration with exact 40-hex commit, nonempty file-level paths, license evidence status, exposure mode, and allowed reuse; fail ambiguous empty fields and unresolved paths.

findings.claim: CONTAINED_METADATA_ONLY and content_not_copied are assertions without an allowed exposure ledger, verbatim-overlap report, schema/prompt fingerprint report, or restricted-copy scan. Because upstream content and licenses were deliberately unavailable to this auditor, absence of copied code, prose, tests, schemas, prompts, or examples is not independently established.
findings.recommended_test: DET-CRP-CONTAMINATION: an authorized isolated scanner must compare normalized text n-grams, AST/token structure, schema keys, prompt phrases, fixtures, and binary hashes against registered source paths; publish only counts, match locations, thresholds, tool hash, and decision hash, and reject material or restricted overlap.

findings.claim: The embargo hash-binds the formal Skill and protected src tree and prohibits two prototype prefixes, but the allowed record provides no workspace-wide allowlist scan proving that component or prototype implementation was not created elsewhere; is_component_implementation=false and is_shadow_prototype=false are unaccompanied by scan evidence.
findings.recommended_test: DET-CRP-EMBARGO: scan the complete tracked workspace against a frozen specification-only allowlist, compare all protected tree/file hashes with the embargo baseline, reject new executable/component/prototype paths anywhere, and emit a canonical hash-bound scan report.

findings.claim: All four registry records exactly match their embedded component provenance records, each frozen component and provenance record is hash-labeled, and the embargo records a release condition plus formal-Skill and protected-source hashes. These are useful integrity anchors but do not resolve CRP-001 through CRP-005.

proposed_rules: Do not accept clean-room provenance until source completeness, role-chain/raw-output preservation, hidden-access exclusion, contamination scanning, and workspace-wide embargo tests pass deterministically.
Keep raw role outputs immutable and separate from normalized specifications; permit only canonical formatting/hash insertion unless a material diff is explicitly re-authored and re-audited.

Require identity-blind, peer-invisible bundles and distinct pseudonymous session identities for author, normalizer, adversarial auditor, and Decision Auditor; agent reuse or unverifiable identity yields RETEST_REQUIRED.
Treat UNKNOWN/UNVERIFIED licenses as metadata-only: no code, schema, prompt, prose, test, fixture, asset, or binary reuse is permitted unless separately licensed and re-frozen.
Any hidden-answer access permanently demotes the affected case; missing access evidence fails closed and cannot be cured by attestation or vote.
abstentions: No upstream repository, third-party content, vault, hidden answer, raw author output, role session ledger, Git history beyond allowed facts, or implementation was inspected.
No claim is made that copying, hidden-answer access, same-agent reuse, or embargo breach actually occurred; the finding is that the allowed evidence cannot exclude them.
Canonical provenance-hash and registry-hash recomputation is not asserted because the allowed inputs do not provide the hashing procedure.
